items.title: Louis Cottrell, Jr. Interview, 1961-08-25
items.q: My father with one at Sonny Greer of the Duke Ellings Band, he had one. Sonny Greer had one.

ctx.x: Do you think you could show us better? Would it be clearer if I brought a bass drum over? There's one across the street.

Well, I guess I could. Now, the other father that I've seen, it's only two that I've ever seen. My father with one at Sonny Greer of the Duke Ellings Band, he had one. Sonny Greer had one. He had one when they were on tour and when they were playing theaters and they would play dances on outside. With Ellington. With Ellington. He had a collapsible drum. He had a collapsible bass drum.
Did it have regular rods? You know, did you tighten up things? Yes, I did have regular rods when it was set up. Once you got it set up, then you tighten up the rods.
